notes: A single mouth-open-reference ArtMesh remains visible while ParamMouthOpenY changes its geometry through the mouth-open-deform warp deformer.
The keyforms record compressed, intermediate, and source-open geometry at parameter values 0, 0.5, and 1.

knownLimitations: This is a deformation proof, not production-ready natural mouth rigging.
Upper lip, lower lip, teeth, tongue, and mouth interior are not separated into independently deformable ArtMeshes.
The mouth-rest ArtMesh is hidden for this proof; the runtime verifies geometry change on the single visible mouth-open-reference ArtMesh rather than an opacity crossfade.
